name: melee_swing
about: Melee: a hostile bat-armed Troika human starts 120 cm (47 units) in front of the player, facing it. After SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT 0xea the weapon split takes slot 604 0x10385e40; slot 599 admits melee; with the player inside melee range and in the 0.7 cone (slot 555 0x1026d9a0: d <= 64 -> CAN_MELEE_ATTACK1 0x51) and no SHOULD_DODGE / SHOULD_BLOCK / SHOULD_KICK / SHOULD_STEPBACK, the tail answers 0xdc SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ATTACK1 (0xdd only with a ranged weapon, slot 308). sched_troika_melee_attack1.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE MELEE_IDLE, FACE_ENEMY, STOP_MOVING, SET_SCHEDULE SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ATTACK1_SWING; _swing: ANNOUNCE_ATTACK 1, TASK_MELEE_ATTACK1, no interrupts. TASK_MELEE_ATTACK1 plays the weapon's melee activity; the clip's hit event reaches HandleAnimEvent 0x10274e30 through DispatchAnimEvents 0x10091880 (slot 258) under PostRun 0x1026c8c4, the swing's trace lands damage on the player (CBasePlayer::OnTakeDamage 0x10163020), and the task completes on IsActivityFinished.
known_red: new: slot 599's attack-coordinator admission 0x1025db70 is a seam answering false (ElysiumNpcTroikaHelpers.cpp:142-146): SCHED_TROIKA_WAIT_FOR_MELEE 0xe4 with the player at 47 units, never MELEE_ATTACK1 (then 3: the hit event rides the world-tick poll)
